llama_adapter_cvec - Represents a control vector adapter that adds bias to specific model layers.
tensor_for - Returns the ggml tensor associated with a specific layer index for the control vector.
apply_to - Applies the control vector to a given tensor by adding the layer-specific bias.
init - Initializes the control vector adapter by creating contexts and allocating zeroed tensors.
apply - Sets the data for the control vector adapter from a provided float array.
llama_adapter_lora - Represents a Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapter for the model.
get_weight - Retrieves the LoRA weight pair associated with a specific tensor name.
llama_adapter_lora_init_impl - Internal function that loads and initializes a LoRA adapter from a GGUF file.
llama_adapter_lora_init - Public function to create and initialize a LoRA adapter instance.
llama_adapter_meta_val_str - Retrieves a string value from the adapter's metadata by key.
llama_adapter_meta_count - Returns the number of metadata key-value pairs in the adapter.
llama_adapter_meta_key_by_index - Retrieves a metadata key by its index in the adapter.
llama_adapter_meta_val_str_by_index - Retrieves a metadata value by its index in the adapter.
llama_adapter_lora_free - Frees the memory associated with a LoRA adapter and unregisters it from the model.
llama_adapter_get_alora_n_invocation_tokens - Returns the number of invocation tokens for the ALORA adapter.
llama_adapter_get_alora_invocation_tokens - Returns a pointer to the array of ALORA invocation tokens.
llm_arch - Enum representing different Large Language Model architectures.
LLM_ARCH_NAMES - Map linking llm_arch enum values to their string names.
llm_kv - Enum representing different key-value metadata types for models.
LLM_KV_NAMES - Map linking llm_kv enum values to their string keys.
llm_tensor - Enum representing different tensor types within a model.
LLM_TENSOR_NAMES - Map linking llm_tensor enum values to their string names.
ggml_tensor - Structure representing a tensor in the GGML library.
ggml_context - Structure representing a computation graph context in GGML.
ggml_backend_buffer_type_t - Type representing the backend buffer type for tensor storage.
ggml_backend_buffer_t - Type representing a backend buffer allocated for tensors.
gguf_context_ptr - Smart pointer managing the lifecycle of a GGUF context.
gguf_init_from_file - Function to initialize a GGUF context from a file.
gguf_get_n_kv - Function to get the number of key-value pairs in a GGUF context.
gguf_get_kv_type - Function to get the type of a key-value pair in a GGUF context.
gguf_get_key - Function to get the key name of a key-value pair in a GGUF context.
gguf_kv_to_str - Function to convert a GGUF key-value pair to a string.
gguf_find_key - Function to find the index of a key in a GGUF context.
gguf_get_val_str - Function to get the string value of a key in a GGUF context.
gguf_get_val_f32 - Function to get the float value of a key in a GGUF context.
llm_arch_from_string - Function to convert a string architecture name to an llm_arch enum.
llama_model - Structure representing the loaded LLM model.
llama_hparams - Structure holding the hyperparameters of the model.
llama_file - Class for handling file I/O operations for model files.
ggml_backend_dev_by_type - Function to get a backend device by its type.

llama_adapter_lora - Represents a Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapter for the model.
get_weight - Retrieves the LoRA weight pair associated with a specific tensor name.
llama_adapter_lora_init_impl - Internal function that loads and initializes a LoRA adapter from a GGUF file.
llama_adapter_lora_init - Public function to create and initialize a LoRA adapter instance.
llama_adapter_meta_val_str - Retrieves a string value from the adapter's metadata by key.
llama_adapter_meta_count - Returns the number of metadata key-value pairs in the adapter.
llama_adapter_meta_key_by_index - Retrieves a metadata key by its index in the adapter.
llama_adapter_meta_val_str_by_index - Retrieves a metadata value by its index in the adapter.
llama_adapter_lora_free - Frees the memory associated with a LoRA adapter and unregisters it from the model.
llama_adapter_get_alora_n_invocation_tokens - Returns the number of invocation tokens for the ALORA adapter.
llama_adapter_get_alora_invocation_tokens - Returns a pointer to the array of ALORA invocation tokens.
llm_arch - Enum representing different Large Language Model architectures.
LLM_ARCH_NAMES - Map linking llm_arch enum values to their string names.
llm_kv - Enum representing different key-value metadata types for models.
LLM_KV_NAMES - Map linking llm_kv enum values to their string keys.
llm_tensor - Enum representing different tensor types within a model.
LLM_TENSOR_NAMES - Map linking llm_tensor enum values to their string names.
ggml_tensor - Structure representing a tensor in the GGML library.
ggml_context - Structure representing a computation graph context in GGML.
ggml_backend_buffer_type_t - Type representing the backend buffer type for tensor storage.
ggml_backend_buffer_t - Type representing a backend buffer allocated for tensors.
gguf_context_ptr - Smart pointer managing the lifecycle of a GGUF context.
gguf_init_from_file - Function to initialize a GGUF context from a file.
gguf_get_n_kv - Function to get the number of key-value pairs in a GGUF context.
gguf_get_kv_type - Function to get the type of a key-value pair in a GGUF context.
gguf_get_key - Function to get the key name of a key-value pair in a GGUF context.
gguf_kv_to_str - Function to convert a GGUF key-value pair to a string.
gguf_find_key - Function to find the index of a key in a GGUF context.
gguf_get_val_str - Function to get the string value of a key in a GGUF context.
gguf_get_val_f32 - Function to get the float value of a key in a GGUF context.
llm_arch_from_string - Function to convert a string architecture name to an llm_arch enum.
llama_model - Structure representing the loaded LLM model.
llama_hparams - Structure holding the hyperparameters of the model.
llama_file - Class for handling file I/O operations for model files.
ggml_backend_dev_by_type - Function to get a backend device by its type.
